name: FEASIBILITY TEST (2026-09-25): Emerald Hill act 1, a 640-px enclosed tunnel (the landed act's is 832), then the opening of Chemical Plant act 1
note: A SEPARATE test clip; s2_ehz_cpz (the landed act) is unchanged. The owner, 2026-09-25: "I'd like the make the connector quite a bit shorter if possible, I just want to test the feesibility." Research: docs/research/2026-09-25-shorter-connector.md. Identical to s2_ehz_cpz except (1) the tunnel is 640 px (x 10976..11615), so Chemical Plant starts at x 11616 and everything after it moves 192 px left; (2) crossing_overrides below. WHY 640. tools/crossing_witness.py measured the landed act: what has to fit inside the tunnel is the palette change AND the background switch (tile overwrite, then the visible-row wipe), and at the camera cap the background took 12 frames into CPZ, the fade 11. With both overrides the palette lands in 1 frame and the background in the 8-frame visible wipe (no tiles to overwrite), so Z2 needs CAM_SCREEN_HALF_W 160 + CAM_MAX_X_STEP 16 x 8 = 288 px each side of the mid-tunnel crossing (576 in all). Z1 then binds: the two zones must be at least TILE_CACHE_COLS - 1 = 79 cells apart, i.e. 632 px, and the collision grid is 16 px, so 640. The crossing sits at x 11296, 320 px from each zone: 2 frames of slack at the camera cap.

crossing_overrides.why: Feasibility test of a shorter connector. SNAP: inside the tunnel the screen draws nothing from CRAM lines 1-3 (the tunnel is on line 0, Sonic and the HUD are line 0, the background is covered: tools/crossing_witness.py --scan counted 0 line 1-3 pixels on every in-flight frame of the landed act), so an instant palette swap there is invisible and the 16-frame fade buys nothing. CO_RESIDENT: Emerald Hill's 141 and Chemical Plant's 237 background tiles share 2, so both fit the 376-tile BG arena at once (they need the band reserve, which a clip act never uses: it has no BgAnim band); the crossing then only repaints the plane and never overwrites tiles, which is what made the background the binding term.

unpainted_remainder.why: THE LAST 672 PX OF THE ACT ARE UNPAINTED, x 13664..14335: the act is grid_w 7 x SECTION_SIZE 2048 = 14336 px (it cannot be 6 sections: Emerald Hill 10976 + tunnel 640 + Chemical Plant 2048 = 13664 > 12288), and Chemical Plant's clip is its first 2048 px exactly as in s2_ehz_cpz. Past x 13664 there is no art and no collision: a player who runs off the end of Chemical Plant's clip falls. The tunnel (x 10976..11615) is painted art on every column. Kept as a two-sided declaration: clip_reachability.py refuses if the painted world ends anywhere else.

donor_bottom_boundary.note: each donor level's own bottom y (s2_donor.level_size); Chemical Plant is pasted 256 px lower, so its boundary would sit at y=2080 in this act

unbounded_fall.why: THE ACT HAS NO BOTTOM, as in s2_ehz_cpz. 1660 painted columns have air below their LAST landing surface: Emerald Hill's 1324 (its 1372 painted columns less the 48 of its two pits), the tunnel's 80 (its floor ends at y=1024 and the act runs to 6144; 640 px / 8 = 80, where s2_ehz_cpz's 832-px tunnel had 104), and Chemical Plant's 256. The other 48 are Emerald Hill's two pits, counted in floorless_columns instead. THE COUNT IS THE CHECK.

floorless_columns.why: EMERALD HILL ACT 1'S OWN TWO BOTTOMLESS PITS, x 4672..4863 and x 9472..9663, exactly as s2_ehz_cpz declares them. Neither the tunnel nor Chemical Plant's first 2048 px adds one. Plane B stays informational (unreachable: no crossover mark).

clips.unaligned_dst_reason: x: Chemical Plant starts where the 640-px tunnel ends (11616 = 10976 + 640), which is not a section boundary: act section 5 holds Emerald Hill's crop end, the tunnel and Chemical Plant's first 672 px. y: lowered 256 px so its start floor (a full block at y=512, s2disasm startpos/CPZ_1.bin) meets the tunnel's floor at y=768, exactly as in s2_ehz_cpz; 256 is a multiple of R12's 16-px collision quantum, so the paste moves art and collision together.
